Name: Deck Toolkit
Author: Lysgarrt

Actions.Name: Monitor Input
Actions.Tooltip: Switches a monitor input (HDMI / DisplayPort / USB-C) via DDC/CI. Can also toggle between two inputs.

Actions.Name: Battery
Actions.Tooltip: Battery level of a Bluetooth headset, controller, mouse … (or a SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless via USB).

Actions.Name: Volume
Actions.Tooltip: Volume down / up / mute for the default or any audio device. Two keys side by side form one slider.

Actions.Name: Twitch Channel
Actions.Tooltip: Shows whether a Twitch channel is live (grey = offline). Press opens the stream.

Actions.Name: Safe Shutdown
Actions.Tooltip: Shuts the PC down only after a second press within 3 seconds.

Actions.Name: SwitchBot Bot
Actions.Tooltip: Presses a SwitchBot Bot directly via the PC's Bluetooth (no hub needed).

Description: Two-key volume slider with mute, Twitch live status, monitor input switching (DDC/CI), battery level of Bluetooth devices, SwitchBot Bot via Bluetooth and a safe shutdown key.
